roadmapLevels.title: Recruitment & Rulebook Decoded
roadmapLevels.titleHi: लेवल 0: भर्ती नियमावली एवं परीक्षा पैटर्न की समझ
actions: Download official notification PDF from uppbpb.gov.in
Verify age limits, category relaxation, and educational qualifications
Understand exact negative marking scheme (-0.5 marks or normalized CBT formula)
Check Physical Standard Test (PST) minimum height and chest requirements

roadmapLevels.title: Core Foundation (NCERT & Basics)
roadmapLevels.titleHi: लेवल 1: आधारभूत संकल्पनाएं एवं एनसीईआरटी अध्ययन
actions: Cover NCERT Class 8-10 History, Geography, and Polity fundamentals
Master Hindi Varnamala, Sandhi, Samas, and Tatsam-Tadbhav classification
Memorize Tables (1 to 30), Squares (1 to 40), Cubes (1 to 20), and Fraction-Percentage conversions

roadmapLevels.title: Complete Syllabus Subject Coverage
roadmapLevels.titleHi: लेवल 2: विषयवार संपूर्ण पाठ्यक्रम का गहन अध्ययन
actions: Complete all 4 sections topic-by-topic according to official UPPRPB syllabus
For SI: Master Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), BNSS, and Special Criminal Acts
For Constable: Solve 50 questions daily in Numerical Ability and Reasoning
For Computer Operator: Cover DBMS, OS, Networking, and Boolean Algebra

roadmapLevels.title: Uttar Pradesh Special GK Dominance
roadmapLevels.titleHi: लेवल 3: उत्तर प्रदेश विशेष सामान्य ज्ञान पर अधिकार
actions: Memorize all 75 UP districts, borders, Sonbhadra quad-border, and Lakhimpur/Hapur extremes
One District One Product (ODOP) mapping for all 75 districts
UP Police Administrative Structure (8 Zones, 18 Ranges, PAC battalions, Dial 112)
UP Fairs (Nauchandi, Bateshwar, Magh Mela) and Folk Dances (Charkula, Nautanki)

roadmapLevels.title: Verified PYQ Dissection & Trend Analysis
roadmapLevels.titleHi: लेवल 4: विगत वर्षों के प्रामाणिक प्रश्नपत्रों (PYQ) का विश्लेषण
actions: Solve all shifts of UP Police Constable (2018, 2019, 2024 Re-Exam)
For SI: Solve all 54 shifts of UP SI 2021 CBT examination
Identify high-frequency repeated themes and question patterns

roadmapLevels.title: Topic Sprints & Speed Practice
roadmapLevels.titleHi: लेवल 5: टॉपिकवार गति अभ्यास एवं सटीकता सुधार
actions: Timed 20-question Topic Quizzes and 50-question Subject Sprints
Target minimum 85% accuracy in General Hindi and Reasoning
Save all incorrect questions directly to the Error Notebook

roadmapLevels.title: Full Official Exam Mock Tests
roadmapLevels.titleHi: लेवल 6: पूर्ण आधिकारिक पैटर्न पर आधारित मॉक टेस्ट
actions: Attempt 2 full-length 120-minute mocks per week under strict timer
Analyze question palette time expenditure and negative marking deductions
For SI: Ensure scoring minimum 35% in all 4 subjects to avoid sectional disqualification

roadmapLevels.title: Error Notebook & Weakness Elimination
roadmapLevels.titleHi: लेवल 7: त्रुटि पुस्तिका (Error Notebook) से कमजोरियों का निवारण
actions: Re-attempt all bookmarked and incorrect questions in Error Notebook
Clarify confusing concepts with original reference notes and books
Eliminate repeated mistakes in negative-marking subjects

roadmapLevels.title: Physical PET / PST Conditioning
roadmapLevels.titleHi: लेवल 8: शारीरिक दक्षता परीक्षा (दौड़) की तैयारी
actions: Morning running sessions: Build up to 4.8 km in 25 min (Male) or 2.4 km in 14 min (Female)
Track distance, time, and pace in the Running Tracker
Ensure chest expansion >= 5 cm for male candidates

roadmapLevels.title: Spaced Repetition Revision Cycle
actions: Review flashcards for UP GK, Law, Polity Articles, and Hindi Grammar
Fast-track review of formulas, square roots, and reasoning shortcuts
Daily revision of Police & Security current affairs

roadmapLevels.title: Exam Day Simulation & Peak Readiness
roadmapLevels.titleHi: लेवल 10: वास्तविक परीक्षा सिमुलेशन एवं अंतिम विजय
actions: Attempt 3 final all-India level simulated papers in the exact exam shift time (10 AM or 3 PM)
Zero new topic introductions; strictly consolidate mastered areas
Arrive at exam center relaxed, confident, and prepared for final selection
